title: Another Disquieting Premonition!
overview: Issei is back with Rias and Asia living in his house, and Kiba starts acting weird when he sees a picture of a holy sword at Issei's house.

title: The Holy Sword Is Here!
overview: Issei gets another warning about the white dragon, and church followers bearing Holy Swords pay a visit to the devils.

title: I'll Destroy the Holy Sword!
overview: Issei and Kiba fight the Xenovia and Irina, and Issei tries to deal with the consequences of their fight.

title: A Strong Enemy Appeared!
overview: Issei and the others team up with the church to fight Freed, but an even greater enemy appears.

title: Decisive Battle at Kuoh Academy!
overview: The Kuoh Academy students fight Kokabiel and his minions to defend their school and their town.

title: Go! Occult Research Club!
overview: The Occult Research Club fights Kokabiel and learns some shocking truths about the power struggle between the angels, fallen angels, and devils.

title: Summer! Bathing Suits! I'm in Trouble!
overview: The Occult Research Club takes over cleaning the pool to thank the student council for their help with Kokabiel, and Issei runs into a lot of trouble.

title: Open House Begins!
overview: Issei learns more about the feud between the Twin Sky Dragons and Rias and Sona have to deal with troublesome family members at Open House.

title: I Have a Junior!
overview: The other Bishop of the House of Gremory is released, and Akeno takes Issei to meet a new acquaintance.

title: Various Three-way Deadlocks!
overview: Issei meets Michael, the Chief of the Angels, and continues training Gasper in the days leading up to the Leaders' Summit.

title: The Leaders' Summit Begins!
overview: Time stops during the Leaders' Summit, and Issei and the others meet a new enemy.

title: Clash of the Twin Sky Dragons!
overview: Issei battles Vali and discovers hidden depths to his power as the Twin Sky Dragons face off.
